newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas ends up, Feb leads on shortcover.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas ends up, Feb leads on shortcover.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures ended higher Wednesday in a moderate session, with February leading the complex up ahead of its expiration on reports that colder Midwest weather helped firm the cash.
February rallied 16.2 cents to expire at $2.986 per million British thermal units. March settled 5.8 cents higher at $2.615. Most others ended up by 0.3 to three cents.

"Colder weather in the Midwest set off some short covering. We're not going to see a repeat of last year (when Feb settled below March and April), but winter is not over and we could move up from here if we get weather," said a trader.
But while fairly cold Midwest and Northeast temperatures this week should boost demand, some said bloated stocks in the East may make any move to the upside a struggle.

"The East has the surplus. We need to see some colder temperatures in the South," the Midwest trader said, noting revised forecasts for colder Midwest and Northeast temperatures into early February caught some by surprise.
Technically, traders pegged March support at the recent $2.46 low and then at the December 30 low of $2.35. Resistance was seen in the $2.80 area.

In the cash, Gulf Coast prices jumped almost 40 cents to mid-to-high $2.90s. Midcontinent pipes gained 35 cents to the low-$2.90s. New York city gate gas was quoted up as much as 15 cents to the $3.50 area.
The 12-month Henry Hub strip rose 3.3 cents to $2.307. NYMEX said an estimated 64,409 Hub contracts traded, up from Friday's revised tally of 57,140.
NYMEX February Alberta natgas settled four cents higher at a new high of $2.24. Permian natgas was untraded Monday. February Alberta and Permian natgas expire Wednesday.

On the KCBT, February closed 0.3 cent lower at $2.607, while deferreds finished down by one to three cents. The East/West spread widened by 16.5 cents to 37.9 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT said 575 contracts traded, up from Friday's total of 292.
